en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural alpine landscape with rolling green hills, scattered houses, and a prominent baroque hilltop church with twin towers on the right. In the foreground stands a boy in traditional alpine clothing holding a statue of the crowned Virgin Mary with the Child Jesus. Mountains rise in the background. Printed captions in German appear at the top left and bottom center, and there is a vertical publisher credit on the right edge.
